data.description: Brandon, 12 Oct: no private repo; docs stay if nothing personal or odd was ever committed. Scope: every file in docs/, DESIGN.md, design/, README, code comments (tight, clear technical language: the Writing rule in CLAUDE.md), every commit message and blob in history (git log -p --all), and origin/tuhdoo (the ledger branch; going public publishes it: decide keep, prune or delete). Report findings to Brandon before changing history. Start when Brandon schedules opening the repo.
data.title: Before the repo goes public: audit every doc, the full git history and the tuhdoo branch for personal or odd content; make the docs logical and tight
